mainEntity.name: How does Uber's insurance policy work for accident claims?

acceptedAnswer.text: Uber maintains different insurance policies depending on the driver's status at the time of the accident. If a driver is logged into the app and waiting for a ride request, a lower coverage applies. When a driver is actively en route to pick up a passenger or during an active ride, Uber's $1 million third-party liability policy typically covers injuries and damages. Understanding which policy applies to your specific situation is crucial, as it dictates the available compensation for medical bills, lost wages, and other damages.
acceptedAnswer.description: Uber's insurance coverage varies based on the driver's status: waiting for a request, en route to a passenger, or during an active ride. The most extensive coverage is for active trips.
